tools.description: Syntax-highlighting diff pager with line numbering and side-by-side view
tools.usage:
git config --global core.pager delta # Set as git pager
delta file1.txt file2.txt # Compare files
echo 'diff --git a/old b/new' | delta # Pipe diff output
git show HEAD | delta # View commit with syntax highlighting

tools.description: Structural diff tool that understands programming language syntax for better comparisons
tools.usage:
difft file1.py file2.py # Compare Python files with syntax awareness
git difftool --tool=difft # Use as git difftool
difft --language=javascript old.js new.js # Specify language
difft --display=side-by-side src/ dest/ # Directory comparison

tools.description: GitHub CLI for repository management, issues, pull requests, and GitHub Actions
tools.usage:
gh repo create myproject --public # Create repository
gh pr create --title 'Fix bug' --body 'Description' # Create pull request
gh issue list --label bug # List issues with label
gh workflow run ci.yml # Trigger GitHub Actions workflow

tools.description: High-performance git status daemon for responsive terminal prompts
tools.usage:
gitstatusd # Run status daemon
export GITSTATUS_DAEMON=$PWD/gitstatusd.exe # Set daemon path
# Used internally by powerlevel10k and other prompt themes
# Provides sub-second git status for large repositories

tools.description: Text-mode interface for Git with powerful browsing, searching, and commit visualization
tools.usage:
tig # Browse repository history
tig status # Interactive staging area
tig blame file.txt # Blame view with navigation
tig show HEAD~5 # Show specific commit
tig --all # View all branches

tools.description: Git Large File Storage extension for versioning large binary files efficiently
tools.usage:
git lfs install # Initialize LFS in repository
git lfs track '*.psd' '*.zip' # Track large file types
git lfs ls-files # List tracked files
git lfs pull # Download LFS objects
git lfs migrate import --include='*.bin' # Migrate existing files
